fullContent:
Stanyajanana Rasayanam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Ashtanga Hridayam 
 Introduction 
 Stanyajanana Rasayanam is a very potent herbal formulation for post natal care. It aids in lactation and also provides strength. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Rice 
 Indian costus root (Saussurea lappa) 
 Wild sugarcane (Saccharum spontaneum) 
 Shashtika (Rice variety) 
 Nut grass (Cyperus rotundus) 
 Sugar 
 Mahuwa (Madhuca longifolia) 
 Indian sarsaparilla (Hemidesmus indicus) 
 Cumin (Cuminum cyminum) 
 Coriander (Coriandrum sativum) 
 Vetiver (Vetiveria zizaniodis) 
 Devil’s grass (Cynodon dactylon) 
 Hygrophila (Asteracantha longifolia) 
 Sugarcane (Saccharum officinarum) 
 Elkara (Oncidopsis Elkara) 
 Madhukapushpa (Madhuca longifolia) 
 Shyonaka (Oroxylum indicum) 
 Trijata (Cinnamon, Cardamom and Cinnamomum tamala) 
 Dhatri (Phyllanthus emblica) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Padmaka (Prunus puddum) 
 Ghee 
 
 Dosage 
 3 to 6 grams twice a day after meals with lukewarm water or milk. 
 Indications 
 
 Post natal care 
 Escalates breast milk production 
 Enhances strength 
 Boosts immunity 
 
 Contraindications 
 Over dosage might lead to gastric irritation. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
